EmailTemplate.subject: Are you considering FX and risk management?
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}},
Is risk management top of mind for your team? At high growth companies, finance and treasury teams are thinking strategically about risk at earlier and earlier stages. You want to be able to clear your organization’s path to growth from all unnecessary blockers -including unwanted risk.
Not all risk is bad, but how do you know the difference and where does A/R and FX fit in?
Join risk management and payments experts <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/worth-the-risk-online-webinar]]> on Tuesday, November 1st at 12pm CT / 1pm ET for a webinar that will discuss:
- What is high-return, "good" risk your team should focus on - How to identify risk that isn't core to your business - Best practices for managing FX and receivables risk
Learn more and register today: Worth the risk? How to think strategically about risk management and receivables <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/worth-the-risk-online-webinar?mkt_tok=MzcyLVFTUS02NDkAAAGHciMdI95fHYB3_pxhaidJdPgahvmlbJgC9dIisGoWr7POtBgeVjrfkk9z77G7R1XEDLeSf8H4uB2rzNEqIw]]>
Thank You,
Flywire for B2B
